================================================================================
a DML trigger with a message
================================================================================

CREATE TRIGGER reminder1
ON Sales.Customer
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS RAISERROR ('Notify Customer Relations', 16, 10);
GO

================================================================================
a trigger FOR DELETE with a block
================================================================================

CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER dbo.trd ON dbo.t FOR DELETE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    INSERT INTO dbo.t_log (id, action) SELECT id, 'D' FROM deleted
END

---

(source_file
  (create_trigger_statement

          (identifier)

                (identifier)))))))))

================================================================================
an INSTEAD OF trigger with options
================================================================================

CREATE TRIGGER dbo.tri ON dbo.v
WITH ENCRYPTION, EXECUTE AS CALLER
INSTEAD OF INSERT
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
IF UPDATE(a) OR COLUMNS_UPDATED() & 2 = 2
    INSERT INTO dbo.t (a) SELECT a FROM inserted

---

  (create_trigger_statement

        (function_call
          (identifier)
          (arguments
            (column_reference
              (identifier))))

              (arguments))

================================================================================
a DDL trigger of the database
================================================================================

CREATE TRIGGER safety
ON DATABASE
FOR DROP_SYNONYM, ALTER_TABLE
AS
IF (@@ROWCOUNT = 0)
RETURN;
   RAISERROR ('You must disable Trigger "safety" to remove synonyms!', 10, 1)
   ROLLBACK
GO
DROP TRIGGER safety ON DATABASE;

---

(source_file
  (create_trigger_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))
    (keyword)
    (keyword)
    (if_statement
      (parenthesized_expression
        (binary_expression
          (global_variable)
          (operator)
          (number)))
      (return_statement))
    (raiserror_statement
      (arguments
        (string)
        (number)
        (number)))
    (rollback_statement))
  (go_statement)
  (drop_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))))

================================================================================
a DDL trigger of the server
================================================================================

CREATE TRIGGER ddl_trig_database
ON ALL SERVER
FOR CREATE_DATABASE
AS
    PRINT 'Database Created.'
    SELECT EVENTDATA().value('(/EVENT_INSTANCE/TSQLCommand/CommandText)[1]', 'nvarchar(max)')

---

(source_file
  (create_trigger_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))
    (keyword)
    (print_statement
      (string))
    (select_statement
      (select
        (field_expression
          (function_call
            (identifier)
            (arguments))
          (identifier)
          (arguments
            (string)
            (string)))))))

================================================================================
a logon trigger
================================================================================

CREATE TRIGGER connection_limit_trigger
ON ALL SERVER WITH EXECUTE AS 'login_test'
FOR LOGON
AS
BEGIN
IF ORIGINAL_LOGIN()= 'login_test' AND
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions
            WHERE is_user_process = 1 AND
                original_login_name = 'login_test') > 3
    ROLLBACK;
END;

---

(source_file
  (create_trigger_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))
    (string)
    (keyword)
    (block
      (if_statement
        (binary_expression
          (binary_expression
            (function_call
              (identifier)
              (arguments))
            (operator)
            (string))
          (binary_expression
            (subquery
              (select
                (function_call
                  (identifier)
                  (arguments
                    (all_columns)))
                (from_clause
                  (table_reference
                    (object_reference
                      (identifier)
                      (identifier))))
                (where_clause
                  (binary_expression
                    (binary_expression
                      (column_reference
                        (identifier))
                      (operator)
                      (number))
                    (binary_expression
                      (column_reference
                        (identifier))
                      (operator)
                      (string))))))
            (operator)
            (number)))
        (rollback_statement)))))

DISABLE TRIGGER Person.uAddress ON Person.Address
ENABLE TRIGGER safety ON DATABASE;
DISABLE TRIGGER ALL ON ALL SERVER;
ENABLE TRIGGER a, dbo.b ON dbo.t
